title: taraxacum laevigatum subsp. calocephalum
intro: Taraxacum laevigatum subsp. calocephalum, commonly known as the smooth dandelion or Chinese dandelion, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion genus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Taraxacum laevigatum subsp. calocephalum include its ability to modulate the immune system, lower blood pressure, and improve liver function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
